name: CSS - First Steps
description: Your first encounter with CSS - learn about colors and basic styling

rules.text: Create a paragraph with some text
rules.hint: Start with HTML first! Create a simple paragraph: <p>Hello CSS!</p>. CSS needs HTML to style!

rules.text: Add a <style> tag to your HTML
rules.hint: CSS goes inside <style> tags! Add: <style></style> at the top of your HTML. This is where we'll write CSS rules.

rules.text: Write your first CSS rule to make the paragraph text red
rules.hint: Inside the style tags, write: p { color: red; }. The 'p' selects all paragraphs, 'color' changes text color, and 'red' is the color value.

completion.message: 🎉 Great start! You've learned about CSS and colors!
